evals.prompt: Create a new skill for generating database migration files.
evals.expected_output: Duplicate search first, PICS structure, verification before shipping
expectations: Searched existing skills for duplicates before creating anything
Read the conventions reference before writing the skill
Wrote SKILL.md with valid frontmatter (name + description) and PICS + Workflow structure
Description states what the skill does and when to use it without summarizing the workflow
Verified the result after writing: frontmatter, section structure, and size under limits

evals.prompt: Audit the skill at plugins/start/skills/refactor — users report it doesn't work reliably.
evals.expected_output: Root-cause audit against conventions with tested fix proposals
expectations: Read the skill file and its reference files before judging
Checked compliance against the conventions reference, not invented criteria
Identified issue categories and root causes, not just symptoms
Proposed specific fixes rather than vague recommendations
Did not ship or claim a fix as correct based on analysis alone
